subject.title: fix(agents): write unresumable notice to transcript for non-deliverable channels

question: Should OpenClaw accept a persistent delivery-mirror transcript row as the WebChat unresumable restart-recovery notice contract after the current-main rebase conflict is resolved?
rationale: The code path is a plausible narrow bug fix, but it creates durable synthetic transcript state and overlaps the broader no-retype restart-recovery direction, so maintainer intent is needed before merge.

options.title: Accept Guarded Transcript Fallback
